plan.purpose: Four-arm physical registration fanout and nonmatching-listener exploration for lazy event encoding
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: Separate actual registration heap diagnostics; proc RSS/HWM remain diagnostic, not PSS or full peak acceptance.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: Four exploratory paired randomized blocks. One operation includes add, full event receive/byte validation, remove, full event receive/byte validation. Per-client sequence continuity includes u16 wrap. Final request barriers detect surplus events. No superiority/equivalence verdict.
plan.hypothesis: Check that deferred encoding does not transfer costs to active event receivers. Zero eligible, one eligible and eight eligible objects; same caller/listener validation on all arms.
plan.retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Report every adverse latency, own CPU, dependency/client CPU, throughput and memory direction; independently investigate new recurring regressions. This pilot cannot close the full ubusd target.
plan.build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
plan.client_control: ca1a912 client/dependencies plus CPU-clock, register-cycle and register-watch patches; identical client on all four fanout arms. Do not pool other client versions.
plan.metric_directions: Lower is better except ops_per_s, which is higher-is-better. Registration ops are complete add/remove cycles.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 3 lanes; object counts (0,)
